senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="N00062">same</cite> <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 11:7">Targ. Ex. XI, 7</cite> <he>למִנְבַּח</he> (ed. Berl. <he>למִיבַּח</he>).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 56:10">Targ. Is. LVI, 10</cite> <he>למיבח</he> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <he>למנ׳</he>).—
<cite ref="Pesachim 113a:2">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> do not live in a place <he>דלא נ׳ בה כלבא</he> where no dog barks.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 59:12">Gen. R. s. 59</cite> end <he>ושמע קל כלביא מְנַבְּחִין</he> (not <he>מנבחים</he>) and hears the dogs bark; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 107">Yalk. ib. 107</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 57a:17">Ber. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>ונַבְּחִי בה נַבּוּחֵי</he> v. <cite ref="I00068"><he>טַבְלָא</he> I</cite>.—
<cite ref="Beitzah 14a:10">Bets. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>נבוחי מְנַבַּח וכ׳</he> the sound produced by pounding spices is a dull one, opp. <cite ref="R00518"><he>צליל</he></cite>.
